text.autoconfig.npc_translator.title: NPC & Items Translator Settings
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.en: Enable or disable the translation mod entirely
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.au: Automatically tries other models of the same provider when rate limit (429) is exceeded
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.tr: Select translation engine. Groq and Gemini are much faster and more accurate than Google.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.mi: Get your API key from console.mistral.ai
Select the Mistral model to use
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.op: Get your API key from openrouter.ai
Select the OpenRouter model to use
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.us: Translates to your Minecraft language if ON. Uses Target Language if OFF.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.au: Translates all incoming chat messages automatically.
Translates item tooltips instantly when hovered.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.gr: Get a free key from console.groq.com
Select the AI model for Groq API.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.ta: The language to translate to if Use Game Language is OFF.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.en: Allow translating items with Google Translate.
Allow translating items with Gemini AI.
Allow translating items with Groq AI.
Allow translating items with Mistral AI.
Allow translating items with OpenRouter AI.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.on: If ON, only messages starting with [NPC] will be translated.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.ge: Get a free key from aistudio.google.com/app/apikey
Select the AI model for Gemini API.
npctranslator.welcome.title: NPC & Items Translator
npctranslator.welcome.desc1: Welcome to NPC & Items Translator mod!
npctranslator.welcome.desc2: This mod translates NPC dialogs and item tooltips.
npctranslator.welcome.desc3: You can use Google Translate (Free), Gemini AI or Groq AI.
npctranslator.welcome.desc4: Open the Mod Menu or type /translate to configure.
npctranslator.api_help.title: API Key Guide
npctranslator.api_help.desc1: You need a free API key to use AI translation.
npctranslator.api_help.desc2: Click the buttons below to open the API websites.
npctranslator.config.keybinds.name: Edit Keybinds
npctranslator.config.keybinds.desc: Opens the original Minecraft Keybinds menu.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.en: Read out chat messages using text-to-speech.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.tt: Adjust voice tone. Below 0.85x gives a deeper/masculine tone, above 1.15x gives a higher tone.
